en-US.description: The Kent Device Enabler is a software addition to LabChart, allowing Kent Scientific devices to stream data into LabChart.
en-US.longDescription:
The Kent Device Enabler is a software addition to LabChart, allowing Kent Scientific devices to stream data into LabChart. The following devices, which are used for monitoring physiological signals from mice and rats, are supported:
- PhysioSuite (including MouseSTAT, MouseVent, RightTemp, CapnoScan)
- SomnoSuite

The Kent Device Enabler allows:
- Automatic recognition of Kent devices by LabChart
- Correct units and ranges in LabChart channels
- Simultaneous recording of data into LabChart alongside a PowerLab
en-US.name: ADInstruments Kent

zh-CN.description: Kent 设备启用器是 LabChart 的软件扩展，可实现 Kent Scientific 设备向 LabChart 的数据流传输。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Kent 设备启用器是 LabChart 的软件扩展，可实现 Kent Scientific 设备向 LabChart 的数据流传输。支持以下用于监测小鼠和大鼠生理信号的设备：
- PhysioSuite（包含 MouseSTAT、MouseVent、RightTemp、CapnoScan 模块）
- SomnoSuite 麻醉系统

该组件具备以下功能特性：
- LabChart 自动识别 Kent 系列设备
- 确保 LabChart 通道显示正确的单位与量程
- 支持与 PowerLab 设备同步进行数据记录
